intro: Prize Wheel gives two through ten choices equal-size slices. A moderator starts one serialized spin; StreamBridge decides the winner first, then the OBS overlay animates to that exact result.

sections.title: 1. Turn on the wheel
sections.description: Keep the add-on disabled until the choices, command, browser source, and chat destinations are ready.

sections.title: 2. Add two through ten choices
sections.description: Write one choice per line. Line wrapping inside the box does not create another choice; only pressing Enter does.

sections.title: 3. Timing
sections.description: The wheel starts quickly, clicks across the studs, eases down naturally, then reveals the server-selected winner.

sections.title: 4. Winner messages
sections.description: Choose every chat that should receive the result. Each template uses {winner} and has the destination's character limit shown in its title.

sections.title: 5. Wheel appearance
sections.description: The hosted source remains transparent outside the wheel panel. Slice colors repeat when you provide fewer colors than choices.

sections.title: Safety and fairness
sections.description: Every configured choice has one equal slice. StreamBridge selects one index before publishing the animation, so OBS timing cannot change the winner.
sections.notice: Prize Wheel is intended for casual stream choices and entertainment. Do not use it for regulated gambling, legal drawings, or high-value prizes. Simulated wizard previews never send chat messages or update the last live spin.
